name: Washington Ecology Streamflow Restoration Competitive Grants
summary: Competitive state grants for Tribes, public entities and nonprofits to carry out watershed projects that improve streamflow and aquatic resources, including riparian and fish habitat improvements. No match is required; the application period is currently closed.

status.quote: Applications are not being accepted at this time. The application period is closed.

pool.quote: Up to $40 million available per biennium

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants are limited to Tribal governments with reservation lands or treaty rights within Washington, public entities (federal, state, local governments, and quasi-governments), and nonprofit organizations.

geography.quote: Eligible applicants are limited to Tribal governments with reservation lands or treaty rights within Washington, public entities (federal, state, local governments, and quasi-governments), and nonprofit organizations.

access.quote: Our streamflow restoration competitive grants help Tribal governments, public entities, and non-profit organizations implement local watershed plans and projects

co_finance_required.quote: Amount of matching funds required: None
